rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: 3-hour proctored test with 4 DSA problems (easy to complex). Campus reports say solve any 3, with shortlisting from 1 full solve; off-campus adds a virtual OA then an onsite OA on Wingspan with a stated 70% cutoff.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.description: In person: solve 1 of 2 Wingspan problems in about 30 min, then resume, SQL, OOP/SOLID, CS fundamentals. Role (DSE / SP L1/L2/L3) is decided after.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 2
rounds.description: For L2/L3: senior lead round with DSA, system design (CAP, HLD/LLD) and project deep dive.

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: HackWithInfy Round 1: 3 coding questions in 3 hours.

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: HackWithInfy Round 2: 4 questions (easy, medium, hard, complex), sometimes onsite.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.description: Pre-placement interview: coding (1 of 2 problems in 40-45 min) plus technical and HR discussion.

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: 100-minute test: mathematical ability, logical reasoning, verbal ability, pseudocode, puzzles.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.description: OOP, DBMS/SQL, SDLC, OS/CN basics and resume.

rounds.name: HR
rounds.description: Self-introduction, projects, night shifts, why Infosys.

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: InfyTQ certification: 10 language MCQs + 10 DBMS MCQs + 2 coding questions, 65% cutoff; an optional Advantage round (3 coding questions) could upgrade to SP/DSE.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.description: Short interview (~20 min) with live coding and fundamentals.

rounds.name: Resume Shortlist
rounds.description: CV screen, then an intro/logistics call with HR.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.description: Technical or behavioral interview, sometimes a technical OA.

rounds.name: Managerial
rounds.description: Project-mentor interview to match the intern to a project.
